text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I... lost...
The back of the world's strongest was so far away."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: However—!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My body feels so hot right now.
Even though the race just ended, I feel like I could burst into a sprint again.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I can't forgive how weak I was,
and losing is truly frustrating. But...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
From here, it absolutely starts from here!
I... will definitely become stronger!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes!!
I look forward to your continued guidance...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And on the way home...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Good work out there
in the Japan Cup, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan...!
Were you watching, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
I watched it with my own two eyes from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And... I have been waiting right here
all this time for you to come.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you were waiting the whole...
Could it be, Grass-chan...!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The way you fought against El was magnificent.
Honestly... watching it gave me chills.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"I doubt there is anyone left
who would question your strength."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Therefore—I challenge you to a duel.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
As someone who, like you, aspires to reach
the end of the road known as racing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The battleground is the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In that race where only the truly formidable gather, chosen by fan votes
from among the strongest Umamusume across both the Classic and Senior classes—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's decide who's at the top, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Special Week was set to challenge the "Monster," Grass Wonder, in the Arima Kinen...!
